study type: Subgroup analysis of a prospective, randomised trial
cohort: The participants were term and late-preterm infants (>34 weeks gestational age at birth) undergoing neonatal stabilisation in the delivery room.
finding: Facemask applications in term and late-preterm infants during neonatal stabilisation are associated with apnoea, and this effect is more pronounced after the first compared with subsequent applications.
followup_time: 30 seconds after facemask application (observations taken 20s before and 30s after each application)
